headline: Ultimate-Agent-Skills-Collection - 40+ Skills for
short_description: A collection of 40+ high-quality agent skills for Claude AI. Supports creative, technical, and enterprise workflows. Benefits operations teams by automating tasks and improving efficiency.
author: ZhanlinCui

sections.overview:
Ultimate Agent Skills Collection is a comprehensive library of 51+ modular instruction packages that extend AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Each skill includes a core instruction file, optional scripts, templates, and references—all validated and ready to use without fine-tuning or API changes. The collection spans creative design, technical development, and enterprise automation, with per-skill control via the skillctl CLI tool. Skills are portable across 11 compatible agents and supported in 6 languages, enabling teams to automate workflows, improve efficiency, and standardize AI agent capabilities across their development environment.
Automate recurring development tasks across multiple IDE agents
Standardize creative design workflows with brand guidelines and theme templates
Extend Claude Code and Cursor with enterprise-grade skills
Manage agent capabilities per IDE using skillctl CLI
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ZhanlinCui/Ultimate-Agent-Skills-Collection`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an expert in [INDUSTRY]. Use the Ultimate-Agent-Skills-Collection to automate the following tasks: [TASK1], [TASK2], and [TASK3]. Provide a step-by-step plan to implement these skills and optimize workflows for [COMPANY].
```

